blocks.text: Lysanias. One name in Luke's list of rulers; Scripture says no more.
Not given Tetrarch of Abilene in the fifteenth year of Tiberius (Luke 3:1); no length is given.
“Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene" is the last ruler in Luke's list for the fifteenth year of Tiberius.”
ROME: 17 RULERS HEROD THE GREAT → PORCIUS FESTUS
"Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene" is the last ruler in Luke's list for the fifteenth year of Tiberius. Luke 3:1
Luke places him in the fifteenth year of Tiberius (Luke 3:1). No outside record gives the years of his rule.
Scripture says nothing of Lysanias beyond his title and region.
Scripture does not say whose son he was or how long he ruled.
